verdict.rationale: Spline documents manual export formats (code export, self-hosted ZIP, spline-viewer) and an MCP server that lets agents drive the open editor. No evidence shows that the MCP server or any API can render screenshots or images or trigger those exports programmatically. The Code API is for runtime manipulation of an embedded scene, not for exporting, and the probe found no OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can render and export designs — screenshots, images, or production formats — through a documented programmatic surface
